label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, and badge headers.

shadows.name: active-glow
shadows.purpose: Floodlight bloom effect on hovered or saved elements.

motion.name: standard-ease
motion.purpose: Smooth transition for inputs, buttons, and layouts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard action button for voting submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #00e676; color: #040a06; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.65rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1ded87; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.5); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Voting Card
components.css: .ds-card-sport { background: #0b1810; border: 1px solid #1c3828; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.25rem; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-sport::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.035) 0%, transparent 55%); pointer-events: none; }

narrative.overview: Cotorra Analytics is a peer-voting performance tracker that channels the raw energy of playing football under stadium floodlights. It rejects corporate SaaS minimalism in favor of a dark, immersive, high-contrast athletic aesthetic. The canvas is a pitch-black night, with lines and elements illuminated by a brilliant turf-lime green.
keyCharacteristics: Deep green-black surfaces resembling night football turf.
High-visibility lime accents (#00e676) for primary interactive states.
Condensed, athletic display fonts in uppercase for strong visual hierarchy.
Seamless transitions, hover glows, and distinct status colorization.

rules.name: The Floodlight Rule
rules.body: The primary lime accent is used on <=15% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point; too much lime makes the dashboard look like a neon billboard rather than a sleek analytics tool.

rules.name: The Scoreboard Rule
rules.body: Display text (Bebas Neue) must always be in uppercase or represent numerical statistics. Sentence-case Bebas Neue is forbidden.

rules.name: The Glow-Response Rule
rules.body: Box shadows are not used as generic drop shadows. They are strictly reactive: applied as a high-intensity glow response on active or hovered states to simulate floodlight bloom.

dos: Do use OKLCH tints dynamically for rating colorization (lime for high, amber for mid, red for low).
Do ensure contrast of body text is kept high against the dark turf background.
Do clamp heading font-sizes on mobile viewports to prevent overflow.
donts: Don't use generic gray drop-shadows on cards.
Don't use side-stripe borders on cards.
Don't use gradient text under any circumstances.
Don't use all-caps body copy for descriptions.
